body: Make a portrait tribute poster from the uploaded photographs. Image 1 is the profile contour; subsequent images are the memory photographs. A large monochrome profile silhouette fills the page; within it, arrange a precise grid of small action and memory photographs. Keep the outer face contour readable. Use {{accentColor}} as the restrained accent color, off-white textured paper and generous margins. Add only the exact name {{name}} in small editorial type.

en.title: Profile memory collage
en.description: A readable profile encloses a grid of personal photo moments.
en.body:
## How to use

Upload one side-profile photo followed by two to four memory photos; supply a name and accent color.

Keep the outer contour legible and identify which input appears in each region.

## Recorded result

The example was generated with the built-in image tool. Its exact model ID was not returned. The recorded run contains the submitted prompt and ordered inputs.
